head: claude/observation-sweep-1a
title: Phase 1A observation sweep: 26 OPEN-ITEMS rows driven to a written outcome on fleet evidence
body:
Parent work object: `WO-20260906-THE-OBSERVATION-SWEEP-54-OPEN-ITEMS-ROWS`. Registry key `pending-20260906T084622Z`. Session `session_01UaZ9boMDajiCZsjVkr4Fnz`.

**Tier 1, landing `self`** (`.github/pr-landing/observation-sweep-1a.json`). Register/observability writes only — no `src/`, no `config/`, no workflows, no VM mutation, no merges. The sweep itself was **read-only on the fleet**.

## Population, stated

`docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json` holds **54 rows**, of which **17 carried `verified_at: never`**. This PR dispositions **26** of them. `verified_at: never` falls **17 → 9**.

| outcome | n |
|---|---|
| **CLOSED** — live mechanism observed on the fleet | 2 |
| **RE-AFFIRMED** — still open, fresh observation written | 17 |
| **NOT OBSERVABLE** — reason recorded, plus what would make it observable | 7 |

Also: 7 of the 28 `landed_unproven` checklist items annotated with fleet observations, and 6 new health-review backlog rows filed.

**A green test, a merged PR and a deploy are none of these.** Every claim below is a `/api/diag/*` read, a bot-API read, or a read of `origin/main`.

## The two CLOSES

**`OI-20260831-PER-ACCOUNT-ARBITRATION`** — all three criteria met, and a contest is confirmed to have occurred, so this is not the quiet-sleeve trap the criterion warns about. Population: 339 soak rows over 8 UTC days.

- **(a) ARMED** — 248/339 rows carry `apply_implemented:true` + `plan_state:planned` + `applied:true`, read off the *effect* field, not `global_mode`.
- **(b) ROUTED** — soak row `2026-09-03T14:51:37.97Z` (SOLUSDT, `starved_count=1`, `rounds_applied=[{trend_donchian_sol, [bybit_1]}]`) is followed **six seconds later** by journal trade `5419` on `bybit_1`/SOLUSDT. Reproduced on 09-05 → trade `5502`, again six seconds later.
- **(c) TIEBREAK** — `trend_donchian_sol` wins 5 elections and now holds 2 closed `bybit_1` rows, against the row's own measured baseline of **0 wins in 60 ticks and zero `bybit_1` journal rows since 2026-07-07**.

**`OI-20260902-SUNSET-CANDIDATES-…-NINE-ARE-UNDISPOSITIONED`** — all 10 legs dispositioned `repair`/`refused`, anchored to a real operator decision (`DEC-20260904-DEMOTE-AND-TUNE-FLOW`), and confirmed dropped off `DUE.md`. Per the row's own rule, all-dispositioned clears it even though nothing was retired.

## Findings that contradict a register

- **`alpaca_live`'s routed real-money leg cannot place an order.** 337 rows; the only 2 since the 08-31 routing are both `tlt_pullback_1h`, both `rejected`, both `dry_run_no_order_placed` — a token emitted only under `_genuinely_dry`. Yet `accounts.yaml` says `mode: live` and the live `/api/bot/config` says `execution: live`. The row cannot clear by waiting: a dry fold can never produce a fill.
- **The prop risk gate is unevidenced at `enforce`.** The complete `prop_ticket_risk_soak` (946 B) reads `global_mode: annotate` on every row and is **7 days stale**, predating the date the register says `enforce` went live.
- **The digest premise is contradicted.** `WORK-DIGEST.json` carries `trigger: "schedule"` — so GitHub cron *does* fire here, while the `push` trigger the change moved onto still has not been observed. Separately `ict-work-digest.timer` is **active** with `outcome: sent`, so *both* carriers are running.
- **The stray-OCA condition has returned.** The sweep has acted exactly once ever (one soak row, 09-01, verified). Today MGC and MHG rest under bare-numeric unkeyed groups again.
- **`OI-20260901-DECISION-ROUNDTRIP`'s headline is false** — 9/9 requests `committed`, answer blocks on `main`, two Telegram taps in the transit log. Re-affirmed rather than cleared because the criterion names the *SPA* as the origin; a re-wording is proposed in the row instead of quietly claiming it.

## The constraint readout, and why "no commit" is readable here

`CONSTRAINT.json` reads `population: 587`, generated `2026-09-02T12:01:38Z`, untouched for four days against a declared daily 05:06 cron. Normally the row's own escape ("a run that fires but commits nothing still clears it") would make silence unreadable — but **`main` holds 628 objects today**, so a regenerating run would have produced a changed readout and *had* to commit. The absence is therefore evidence.

## What I could not observe, and why

- **Any criterion needing a GitHub Actions run `event`.** `api.github.com` returns **HTTP 403** at this container's proxy, and **no Actions MCP tool exists in this session's surface** — CLAUDE.md's claim that `actions_list` works does not hold for a sub-session container. This blocks the scheduled-run half of the constraint-readout, review-packet, PR-queue-watcher, digest and replay-pregate rows.
- **`/api/diag/log_file` is tail-only, hard-capped at 1000 lines, no offset.** So `OI-20260902-BYBIT-COVERAGE-BASIS`'s "3 distinct UTC days" clause **cannot be checked through the instrument the row names** — 1000 lines of that soak is 3h35m. Filed with a proposed fix (a bounded rolling receipt, the shape `work_digest_receipt.json` already uses).
- **Cold-session rows** (session brief, cycle priority, API reference, constraint-refusal). I am structurally disqualified — dispatched onto this exact register. Recorded rather than fudged. **One is an honest self-report:** I needed `log_file`'s contract mid-task, did **not** reach for `docs/reference/bot-api-reference.md`, and re-derived it from `diag.py` — precisely the informative failure `OI-20260902-API-REFERENCE-…` watches for, so it stays OPEN.
- **Operator's-phone rows** (channel separation, `/status` commands) and **anything needing a VM mutation** (`cancel-ib-order`, a `get-env` read) — outside a read-only dispatch.

## New backlog rows (6)

`alpaca_live` dry-fold · prop soak stale-at-annotate · `log_file` tail-cap vs soak criteria · stray unkeyed OCA recurrence · **live `bybit_1`/SOLUSDT SL legs at 2393% of position** · one repeating exception that is **47% of the entire operator ERROR+ feed** (the alarm-fatigue P1 shape).

## Safety of the diff

`OPEN-ITEMS.json` **round-trips at no `json.dumps` setting** (indent widths vary 2–8). It was patched **surgically**: 52 insertions / 52 deletions, exactly the 26 `verified_at` + 26 `observation` lines, row order preserved, no other field and no top-level key touched — asserted programmatically before writing. `MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json` does round-trip (verified) → 7±7 lines. Backlog rows went through `scripts/ops/backlog_append.py` → 61 insertions / 1 deletion for 6 rows, no reformat.

**I changed no `state` field on `MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json` — the manager owns those.** Recommended transitions are written into each item's `note`; the clearest is **MI-36**, whose fix I observed working verbatim in the live error feed.

## Guards

`python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` → **PASS 47 · FAIL 4 · SKIP 36**, then resolved:

- `session-brief-guard` — a **real** failure caused by this diff (it changes the registers). Fixed by `render_session_brief.py --write` in the second commit; re-check is clean. All changes confined to the generated block, verified programmatically.
- The other three (`trainer-capture-watch`, `artifact-validity`, `operator-owed`) fail **only because `run_guards` calls `python3 -m pytest` and pytest is absent from that interpreter in this container**. Run against the real binary they **all pass: 24 + 66 + 54 = 144 tests**. Reporting the tooling gap rather than calling them green on trust.
